memory_bumble_beginning.title: The Beginning
lines: It started with a small swipe on Bumble.
Not a grand plan. Just two people deciding to say hello.
And somehow, that ordinary hello kept moving forward.

memory_uniqlo_first_meeting.title: Uniqlo
lines: The first time we met in person was at Uniqlo.
I said I needed to buy pants, which is not exactly a movie-scene reason to meet someone.
But it was real. It was simple. And I still remember it.

memory_marugame_first_meal.title: Marugame Udon
lines: After Uniqlo, we ate together at Marugame Udon.
That was our first meal, and it belongs right after that first meeting.
A small bowl of food became the start of many ordinary meals I would remember.

memory_tuku_after_work.title: Tuku After Work
lines: At first, I did not understand why you liked going to Tuku so much.
You told me kopi susu tetangga was better without sugar. I was not convinced.
So I ordered sugar on the side, did not use it, and still thought it would be wasteful not to ask for it.

memory_honda_beat_rides.title: Honda Beat Rides
lines: Then there was that month when we went almost every evening after work.
We rode the Honda Beat, got coffee or food, and usually had no special plan.
Those ordinary rides became one of the parts I treasure most.

memory_cat_cemplung.title: Cemplung
lines: Cemplung was the first one who stopped running away from me.
I thought maybe I had finally earned his trust.
Later I learned he may have been pretending his leg hurt, which is also very Cemplung.

memory_cat_mumu.title: Mumu
lines: After Cemplung, Mumu started staying nearby too.
The house felt a little less like I was a suspicious guest.
One cat trusting me made the next small step feel possible.

memory_cat_sisil.title: Sisil
lines: Then Sisil stopped running away.
Not all at once, not dramatically. Just a little closer than before.
That was enough to make me feel like I was slowly becoming part of your world.

memory_cat_bubu.title: Bubu
lines: Bubu was last, of course.
She is cute, moody, and has scratched me twice, so her approval had conditions.
When even Bubu stopped running away, it felt like the whole family had finally let me in.
